title.narrative: Greening the future of rural and vulnerable communities in Upper Egypt
Rendere più verde il futuro delle comunità rurali e vulnerabili nell’Alto Egitto

description.narrative: L’Azione mira a contribuire alla riduzione della povertà del Paese e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di sviluppo sostenibile, attraverso il miglioramento della sicurezza alimentare e della resilienza economica dei gruppi vulnerabili. In particolare, l’empowerment dei giovani e delle donne gioca un ruolo cruciale nell’Azione. L’obiettivo è rispondere alle pressanti sfide affrontate dai villaggi rurali più vulnerabili dell’Alto Egitto, rafforzando la sicurezza alimentare, migliorando la resilienza e diversificando i mezzi di sussistenza.

The Action aims at contributing to the country’s poverty reduction and to the achievement of the sustainable development goals, through improved food security and economic resilience of vulnerable groups. Particularly, the empowerment of youth and women plays a crucial role in the Action. It aims to respond to the pressing challenges faced by the most vulnerable rural villages in Upper Egypt, by enhancing food security, improving resilience, and diversifying livelihoods.

By 2030, ensure that people everywhere have the relevant information and awareness for sustainable development and lifestyles in harmony with nature

Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns

Promote development-oriented policies that support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, creativity and innovation, and encourage the formalization and growth of micro-, small- and medium-sized enterprises, including through access to financial services
Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all
Support developing countries to strengthen their scientific and technological capacity to move towards more sustainable patterns of consumption and production
